notes.title: Steam Next Fest June 2025 - It's a wrap!
notes.notes:
[p]A big thanks to everybody who checked out the Gombo Demo and/or wishlisted it during Steam Next Fest 2025! [/p][p]We appreciate the feedback we received through various channels. 
Feel free to join the community on the Discord server. [/p][p][/p][p]The demo will stay online and we'll also keep maintaining it. 
Stay tuned for more news around Gombo soon![/p]
